evals.name: wallet-adjust-fields
evals.prompt: Add amount and reason fields to the wallet adjust dialog using useAppForm and a Zod schema. Submit via the existing Orval mutation and invalidate the wallet query on success.
evals.expected_output: Form uses useAppForm, field.TextField or NumberField, Zod schema in domain schemas/, mapForm helper if needed, sonner toast, get*QueryKey invalidation.
assertions: Output does not import useForm from @tanstack/react-form
Output uses form.AppField with field.TextField or field.NumberField
Output invalidates queries with a generated get*QueryKey factory
Zod schema lives in domains schema file not in src/services/

evals.name: edit-mode-reset
evals.prompt: Brand edit form should load existing brand data from useGetBrandsId and reset the form when data arrives — match brand-form.tsx pattern.
evals.expected_output: useGetBrandsId with enabled flag, useEffect calling form.reset with mapped values, mapper in lib/brand-mapper.ts.
assertions: Output uses useEffect to reset form when entity loads
Output uses a mapper function rather than passing API DTO directly as form values
Output uses Orval useGet* hook with enabled tied to edit mode
